extension_description.message: Search multiple engines and chat with multiple AI assistants on one page — type once at the bottom and every panel searches / starts a conversation simultaneously.

app.previewBanner.message: Preview mode (extension not loaded): AI chat won't actually happen. For full features, enable "Developer mode" → "Load unpacked" at chrome://extensions and select the multi-ai folder.

app.queryPlaceholder.message: Type here, press Enter or Send — all panels search / start a conversation at once

app.panelsSection.message: Panels (count is customizable; they share the row width evenly)

app.saveWs.message: Save current panels as a workspace

app.emptyPanels.message: No panels yet — click "＋ Panels" in the top-right, or pick a workspace at the top.

app.statusPreview.message: Preview mode: load the extension for real AI chat

app.statusNotReady.message: Panel not ready, refresh and retry

app.statusLoggedOut.message: Not logged in or login required

app.statusNotFound.message: Input not found (site may have changed)

app.ceAlertPercent.message: The URL template must contain the %s placeholder

app.ceAlertScheme.message: The URL must start with http(s)://

app.ceAlertDuplicate.message: An engine with this name already exists

popup.desc.message: Open multiple search engines and AI chat on one page — type once at the bottom and all panels search / chat at the same time.

popup.hint.message: Tip: log in to each AI site first; use "↗" on a panel to open the site in a new tab for login.

ad.looksLoggedOut.message: Possibly not logged in or on a login page

ad.inputNotFound.message: Input box not found (site may have changed)

ad.notConfirmed.message: Text entered, but sending not confirmed (button may be disabled or site changed)
